title: Plastic Kitchen Funnel Set of 3, Round Kitchen Funnels for Filling Bottles, Durable and Multifunctional Funnels for Filling Canning, Cooking, Lab or Car Oil
description:
About this item
【You Will Receive】: We will provide you with three different sizes of DolphinSmile funnel set: small funnel 4.4 x 3.3 in; medium funnel 5.5 x 4.4 in; large kitchen funnel 5.8 x 5.2 in. Regardless of the size of the container, these three funnel can be accurately matched to meet diverse needs and avoid spills or waste.
【Durable Material】: DolphinSmile funnels for kitchen use filling bottles is made of high-quality PP plastic material, which is super durable and not easy to deform or break even after long-term use. Regardless of the type of liquid, it can maintain stable performance and allow your filling work to proceed smoothly.
【Practical Design】: This DolphinSmile kitchen funnel adopts a practical design with a conical structure and a narrow mouth. Oil funnel can reduce the resistance of the liquid during the flow process, transfer liquids or small particles more quickly and accurately, avoid spills, drips or waste, and avoid uncontrollable situations.
【Easy to Clean & Store】: You only need to rinse with clean water or put it in the dishwasher to keep the DolphinSmile funnels for filling bottles clean as new. In addition, we have equipped the side of each car funnel with a hanging hole, so you can nest and stack them and hang them for storage, or stack them and store them directly.
【Multi-scenario Application】: DolphinSmile Canning funnels have a wide range of uses. When cooking, you can easily transfer oil, sauces, liquid seasonings, etc.; in the laboratory, it can safely and effectively transfer liquids; when maintaining the car, it can help you accurately add engine oil, coolant, etc to avoid spills and waste.
